_comment: Local test cameras (192.168.1.121 ingress / 192.168.1.125 egress). PLACEHOLDER full-frame polygons — we do not have tuned polygons for these specific cameras anywhere in the codebase. Tune against actual frames at first live test before relying on visit data.
_doc_polygon: Polygon points as [x, y] in normalized 0.0-1.0 coordinates (fraction of frame width/height)
_doc_camera_id: Per-zone camera_id is the LOGICAL role (0=ingress, 1=egress). For lalaland: physical cam1 (bowtie@192.168.1.121) → camera_id=0, physical cam2 (admin@192.168.1.125) → camera_id=1.
